identity.name: Credential Extraction from Unix Files via Linux Shell
identity.summary: An attacker uses a Linux shell to extract credentials from Unix password and shadow files. Cortex detects this behavior through process execution and file access patterns.
identity.description: An attacker uses a Linux shell to extract credentials from Unix password and shadow files. Cortex detects this behavior through process execution and file access patterns.

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of wget to download malware

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Extracting Credentials from Unix Files
biocs.description: Process accessing password and shadow files for credential extraction
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/usr/bin/wget' and action_file_path IN ('/etc/passwd', '/etc/shadow')

abiocs.name: Unusual File Access for Credential Extraction
abiocs.description: Process accessing sensitive Unix credential files outside of normal behavior
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE_ACCESS
| filter action_file_path IN ('/etc/passwd', '/etc/shadow')
| filter actor_process_image_name != '/usr/sbin/cron'
| filter actor_process_image_name != '/usr/sbin/sshd'

xql_queries.name: Process Accessing Sensitive Unix Files
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE_ACCESS
| filter action_file_path IN ('/etc/passwd', '/etc/shadow')
| filter actor_process_image_name != '/usr/sbin/cron'
| filter actor_process_image_name != '/usr/sbin/sshd'
| comp count() by actor_process_image_name, action_file_path
